messages.subject: FW: NIMBLE virtual workshop, May 26-28
parts:
Hi all,

I guess you all know what Nimble is (in case not: it's a great new, Bayesian model-fitting software that lets you describe the models in the BUGS language --- for the most part). So this workshop may be interesting.

Best regards  --- Marc


From: nimble...@googlegroups.com [nimble...@googlegroups.com] on behalf of Chris Paciorek [christophe...@gmail.com]
Sent: Friday, March 05, 2021 16:49
To: nimble-users; nimble-...@googlegroups.com
Subject: NIMBLE virtual workshop, May 26-28

Hi all,

We’ll be holding a NIMBLE virtual training workshop, May 26-28, from 8 am to 1 pm US Pacific (California) time.

Details can be found here.

If you are interested in attending, please pre-register at https://forms.gle/6AtNgfdUdvhni32Q6. This will hold a spot for you and allow us to learn about your specific interests. 

-Chris
For the NIMBLE Development Team
